card.line: Lo-debar was a town in Gilead, east of the Jordan, where Machir lived. It matters because Mephibosheth lived there before David showed him kindness.

moments.title: David sends for Mephibosheth
moments.text: Ziba tells David that Jonathan's son is in Lo-debar at the house of Machir. King David has him brought from there and promises him kindness, his grandfather's land, and a place at the king's table.

moments.title: Machir helps David
moments.text: When David comes to Mahanaim, Machir from Lo-debar meets him. He and others bring beds, food, and supplies for David and his hungry, tired people.
